name: std-version-history
description: std-version-history — wiki/CMS revision history with diff + rollback. Browses revisions; opens detail in `viewing_single`; compares two revisions in `comparing` with intrinsic version-diff; persists rollback. `RevisionManage` is a rebindable single-entity trait: a consumer rebinds it to its own entity via `linkedEntity`. `config.scopeField` names the Revision field holding the parent document id; a page-mounted `{id}` route param scopes INIT's own fetch, and a consumer forwards SHOW_HISTORY { key } (via a `listens` override) to rescope the feed to one document — empty scopeField (default) or no id keeps today's unfiltered global feed. Rollback and retry refetches stay scoped.

fields.description: The snapshotted body of the revision — plain text or the rich-text HTML a document-look record carries. Rollback hands the whole row back to the host, which restores content onto the source document.
fields.name: content

fields.description: A brief explanation of the revision's changes.
fields.name: summary

fields.description: The current search query the user submitted.
fields.name: searchTerm

fields.description: The parent document id the feed is currently scoped to, set by SHOW_HISTORY. Empty when browsing the unfiltered global feed.
fields.name: scopeKey

scopeField.description: Revision entity field holding the parent document's id. When set, a page-mounted {id} route param scopes INIT's fetch, and a SHOW_HISTORY { key } event rescopes the feed, to rows whose scopeField equals the id/key; rollback and retry refetches stay scoped too. Empty (default) or no id = unfiltered global feed, unchanged from prior behavior.
scopeField.label: Scope field
